title: One shared owner command set for every Windy agent (Chat roster + windyfly)
description: Grant 10-07: one ecosystem list of slash commands, not one per engine. ~11 commands, same names/args/help in both engines. Owner-only: an agent obeys a command only from its OWNER (a sibling or peer agent can never run one). A phone or desktop client fetches this list (GET /api/v1/onboarding/commands) for its suggestions and shows only what the target agent's engine supports. windyfly's other ~90 commands are NOT part of this set and stay as they are. A command an engine does not support answers honestly ('I don't keep memory yet'), never silently. /panic, rescue and reset are NOT in this set: they stay engine-local and OWNER-only (windyfly's), so a client must not expect them from this list.
x-rules: Owner only. The command text is an ordinary owner m.text (leading slash); no special event.
A command is deterministic code in the runtime, not a model turn: it answers without a model call (except `usage` / `status`, which read Mind / the runner).
`supported_by` lists the engines that implement it today; a client hides a command whose engine it knows is not listed, an unknown engine shows all.
Answers are plain text, one short block, never a secret (no tokens, keys, internal ids beyond the passport).
`undo` was dropped in 1.1.0: no engine implements it, and a list offers only what an engine really runs. It returns when one does.
